data.description:
Four historical URLQuery reports from September 16, 2026 (UTC) preserve Itty Bitty programs configured to fetch International Energy Agency material and send returned text to the same custom webhook resource. Their report times are 17:09:45, 17:12:31, 17:31:47 and 17:33:49. Original report links and identifiers are withheld because they can expose the receiving resource and forwarded material. No collector identifier, payload content or source-response body is included in this submission.

The first report preserves program intent but records only carrier-page traffic. The other three record forwarding. Nine separately retained bodies match the hashes of recorded IEA source responses and declared callback upload lengths, totaling 2,383,597 bytes. Eight correspond to HTTP 200 source responses and one to an HTTP 404 page. URLQuery's retained POST records do not themselves contain the POST-body field; the content verification joins separately preserved bodies by response hashes and lengths. This supports the aggregate forwarding finding rather than relying only on instructions or HTTP status. The underlying bodies and their access paths are not shared here.

Several programs seek Korean oil, gas and coal import information corresponding to inputs for public DeepSearchQA question 560. Three belong to the previously reviewed six-report task-match group; the fourth is a related coal-retrieval neighbor linked by the common output destination. No final benchmark answer is established. The sole public evidence link supplied here is the pinned benchmark CSV, which establishes the public task wording only; it is not independent access to the withheld scanner evidence or proof that these programs ran a formal evaluation.

The common resource supports a connected collection/output workflow, shared destination, or copied program. It does not identify the destination's owner or prove one submitter. No demonstrated identifier joins this cluster to the August benchmark-corresponding Arquivo requests. The public benchmark's publisher is not thereby the operator. No AI company or model is attributed, and investigator reproduction remains possible. The IEA is intergovernmental, so the form's national/state-government classification is marked Unsure. This is an already-reviewed bounded case, not a claim of a substantial untapped source.
data.summary: Four September 16, 2026 URLQuery programs shared an external webhook destination for IEA material. Three recorded forwarding nine response bodies totaling 2,383,597 bytes; several programs correspond to DeepSearchQA's Korean fuel-import task.
